propositions: Blocking-link comparability keyed on ticket type tier prevents a task and story that are both direct children of the same epic from holding a direct dependency, wrongly promoting the source to the epic and writing an epic-blocked-by-its-own-child edge.

Comparability should be structural: any two tickets under the same parent may hold a dependency, and cross-subtree dependencies escalate to the nearest common ancestor's children, using a virtual-root sentinel so parentless tickets are treated as siblings.

The redundancy guard is computed from the original source/target before promotion, so the promoted redundant pair that is actually written is never re-checked, letting invalid ancestor-blocking edges through.

The redundancy check must be recomputed from the resolved pair as an ancestor-descendant test within the blocking branch only, while non-blocking relations keep the original-pair check and gain no new rejections.
The ancestor walk is capped at max_hops=2, truncating deeper chains and forcing the chain-root fallback; the cap must be removed and a cycle guard added so malformed parent loops terminate.
Cousins in different sub-trees now escalate to their respective parents rather than linking directly, an intended behavior change surfacing more redirect records.
